mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'open' returns currently active/open tenders. 'awarded' pages through the historical awarded-contract ledger (includes supplier and declared beneficial-owner info). 'detail' fetches full information for specific process IDs (e.g. the 'id' field from an 'open' record, or 'proceso_compra.id' from an 'awarded' record).

entidad.title: Institution name contains (open / awarded mode)
entidad.description: Optional. Filters to tenders/awards from one government institution -- a case-insensitive substring match (e.g. "Salud" matches health-related institutions). In 'open' mode this resolves to COMPRASAL's own institution filter; in 'awarded' mode COMPRASAL's server-side institution filter is broken (verified during recon -- it silently ignores the parameter), so this is applied client-side after fetching each page, which can be slower for a rare institution.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of records to return. 'open' mode: all currently-open processes fit in one response (~370 typically), so this just caps how many are returned. 'awarded' mode: the historical ledger has tens of thousands of records, paged 100 at a time -- this actor pages through until it reaches this many (matching, if 'entidad' is set) results.

fetchDetail.title: Also fetch full detail per process (open / awarded mode)
fetchDetail.description: When true, also fetches each process's full detail page and merges it into a 'detail' sub-object on the same record. Slower -- one extra request per process.

processId.title: Process ID (detail mode)
processId.description: A single numeric process ID to fetch (the 'id' field from an 'open' mode record, or the 'proceso_compra.id' field from an 'awarded' mode record -- NOT the human-readable 'codigo_proceso' string).

processIds.title: Process IDs (detail mode)
processIds.description: Multiple numeric process IDs to fetch in one run. Combined with 'processId' if both are set.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many detail pages to fetch in parallel (used by 'detail' mode, and by 'open'/'awarded' mode when 'fetchDetail' is on).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
